K8sGenBench: datasets, generation, evaluation pipeline, results and paper
Initial import of the research project: 12 prepared project datasets (7 evaluated),
LLM generation (API and web-relay) with stored outputs, the D1-D6 evaluation pipeline
(kind cluster, scanners, deploy, smoke and fault injection), per-configuration results,
analysis scripts (stats, figures, tables) and the LaTeX paper. PROGRESS.md is the full log.
